entities.name: Regina Rajchrtová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Regina Rajchrtová, married Kordová, is a former professional tennis player from Czechoslovakia who competed for her native country at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. On 1 April 1991 she reached a career high singles ranking of 26, while on 27 August 1990 she reached a career high doubles ranking of 45.
